facts.text: Ancient Romans used urine as mouthwash due to its ammonia content
facts.voiceNarration: Did you know? Ancient Romans actually used urine as mouthwash because of its ammonia content!
facts.imageDescription: A Roman citizen holding an amphora in an ancient bathhouse, classical architecture, historical painting style

facts.text: The Colosseum could be filled with water for mock naval battles
facts.voiceNarration: The Colosseum wasn't just for gladiators - it could be flooded for epic naval battles!
facts.imageDescription: The Roman Colosseum filled with water, ships engaged in battle, dramatic lighting, aerial view

facts.text: Romans invented the first shopping mall, Trajan's Market
facts.voiceNarration: Romans invented the world's first shopping mall, called Trajan's Market, over 2000 years ago!
facts.imageDescription: Trajan's Market bustling with merchants and shoppers, multi-level Roman architecture, vibrant market scene

facts.text: Purple dye was worth more than gold in ancient Rome
facts.voiceNarration: In ancient Rome, purple dye was actually worth more than gold itself!
facts.imageDescription: Roman emperor wearing purple toga, gold coins scattered, luxury palace interior, regal atmosphere

facts.text: Romans used lead in their water pipes and cooking pots
facts.voiceNarration: Romans unknowingly poisoned themselves by using lead in their water pipes and cookware!
facts.imageDescription: Ancient Roman aqueduct and lead pipes, water flowing, architectural engineering marvel

facts.text: The Roman Empire lasted over 1000 years
facts.voiceNarration: The Roman Empire lasted for more than a thousand years, shaping Western civilization!
facts.imageDescription: Timeline visualization showing Roman Empire expansion across Mediterranean, maps and dates

facts.text: Gladiators were mostly slaves and prisoners of war
facts.voiceNarration: Most gladiators weren't heroes - they were slaves and prisoners forced to fight!
facts.imageDescription: Gladiators in arena, crowd watching, dramatic combat scene, ancient Colosseum atmosphere

facts.text: Romans ate dormice as a delicacy
facts.voiceNarration: Wealthy Romans considered dormice a delicacy and ate them at fancy banquets!
facts.imageDescription: Roman banquet scene, elaborate feast, wealthy Romans dining, opulent setting

facts.text: The Roman army built 50,000 miles of roads
facts.voiceNarration: The Roman army built an incredible 50,000 miles of roads across their empire!
facts.imageDescription: Ancient Roman road stretching into distance, soldiers building, engineering achievement

facts.text: Julius Caesar was stabbed 23 times by senators
facts.voiceNarration: Julius Caesar was betrayed and stabbed 23 times by his fellow senators!
facts.imageDescription: Roman Senate chamber, dramatic assassination scene, historical moment, classical art style
